fields.title: Onam 2026
fields.description: **Onam Celebration – Welcome Description**We warmly welcome you all to our vibrant Onam celebration, taking place on **10th September 2026 at 10:00 AM in Thalassery**. Onam is a festival that brings together joy, tradition, and togetherness, celebrating the rich cultural heritage of Kerala.This special occasion marks the homecoming of the legendary King Mahabali, symbolizing prosperity, unity, and happiness. Today’s program is thoughtfully organized to reflect the spirit of Onam through a variety of cultural performances, traditional games, and festive activities.As we begin this celebration, we invite everyone to immerse themselves in the beauty of our traditions—enjoy the colorful Pookalam, experience the rhythm of traditional music and dance, and share the warmth of togetherness with family and friends.Let us celebrate this Onam with joy in our hearts, smiles on our faces, and a spirit of unity that brings us all closer.**Wishing you all a Happy and Prosperous Onam!**

fields.title: Music Fest
fields.description:
Get ready for an electrifying night of music, energy, and unforgettable vibes at the **Music Fest Concert 2026**!

📅 **Date:** May 26, 2026
📍 **Location:** Kannur Police Ground

Join us for a spectacular live concert featuring dynamic performances by special guests **Vedan** and **Hanan Shah**, who are set to light up the stage with their unique sounds and powerful presence. From high-energy beats to soulful melodies, this event promises a perfect blend of music that will keep the crowd buzzing all night long.

Whether you're coming with friends or looking to meet fellow music lovers, this festival is the ultimate destination to celebrate rhythm, culture, and live entertainment. Expect an immersive atmosphere with vibrant lighting, great sound, and unforgettable moments.

Don’t miss out on one of the most exciting music events of the year—mark your calendars and get ready to experience the magic live!
